newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp still a speculative buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp still a speculative buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc has reiterated its speculative buy rating on Sao Paulo state-owned Cesp power firm and improved its 1996 forecast for the company.
-- The brokerage said Cesp posted a net loss again in the third quarter but "trends are favorable."
-- It also cited the company's progress in renegotiating its 2.6 billion-real debt to federally owned Eletrobras power firm and a potential agreement to finish the Porto Primavera power mill.

-- "Cesp is a stock that is charged with upside potential but, until we see the realization of asset disposals or an improvement in the tariff structure, we are maintaining our speculative buy recommendation," Fleming said.
-- The brokerage's 1996 forecast for Cesp is a 507.9 million real loss, up slightly from its previous estimate of a 557.9 million-real loss.
-- Cesp preferred closed Tuesday at 32.90 reais while its voting common share ended at 39.00 reais on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
